content.title: Top 15 Things to do in Santa Barbara
content.text: 🗺️Get your FREE Digital Guide of this tour here: https://www.triptipswithchris.com/shop Explore Santa Barbara, California with me on this self-guided walking tour! From peaceful gardens and historic landmarks to local food spots and ocean views — this tour covers the best things to do in Santa Barbara all within walking distance. We’ll start at the historic Old Mission, continue to the beautiful Alice Keck Park Memorial Garden, stroll down State Street, visit the stunning Santa Barbara County Courthouse, and make our way all the way to Stearns Wharf and the vibrant Funk Zone. Along the way, I’ll share history, insider tips, and plenty of food recommendations — from delicious tacos and Italian pizza to local wine tasting rooms. If you’re planning a trip to Santa Barbara, or just love exploring new places, this is the perfect guide to help you plan your visit! 👉 Next up: My walking tour of Solvang, just a 45-minute drive from Santa Barbara: • Top 10 Things To Do In Solvang, CA: Full D...
